B.text: If the green bars encode monthly Museum C visitor counts on the upward-increasing y-axis, the bar above each month label is that month's count, and the dashed line labeled "Average" is the average benchmark on the same scale, then a month whose bar top aligns with that line is at the average; assuming the routing labels map at-average results to average-level monitoring, select the average-level option.
B.conditions: Applies to the Museum C July dashboard and assumes the labeled Average line is the benchmark governing the three route choices.
